title: DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18862v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B

translated_title: DoubtLess：面向高效推理的无训练对比解码方法
translated_abstract: 推理模型通过长思维链（CoT）取得了优异的性能，但在解决问题时往往消耗的token数量超过了实际需要。现有的缩短CoT的方法要么需要对每个模型进行额外训练，要么在模型隐藏状态中加入固定的引导向量，要么使用诸如提前停止或禁用"wait"等词汇的解码启发式策略，这些方法可能会降低准确性。我们提出了DoubtLess，这是一种无需训练的解码方法，由一个小得多的推理模型引导大模型趋向简洁。小模型将大模型迄今为止的CoT读取两次，一次以简洁风格提示（简洁思考者），一次以冗长风格提示（冗长思考者），其两个logit向量之间的差异经过强度缩放后，在CoT的每一步都加到大模型的logits上。在竞赛数学、研究生水平科学和竞赛编程等七个基准测试上，DoubtLess缩短了Qwen3-32B的CoT
tldr: 提出了无需训练的对比解码方法DoubtLess，通过让小模型分别以简洁和冗长两种提示读取大模型的思维链，并利用其logit差异引导大模型生成更简短的推理链，从而在不牺牲准确性的前提下实现高效推理。
en_tdlr: DoubtLess is a training-free contrastive decoding method that steers large reasoning models toward shorter chains of thought by using the logit difference of a smaller model prompted to be brief versus verbose, improving reasoning efficiency without accuracy loss.
